# lebop v0.0.9

## Changes

- Upgrade `@linear/sdk` from 95.0.0 to 99.0.0. No lebop source changes were
  required. The upstream breaking changes in 96–99 do not touch any lebop
  surface: `JiraUpdateInput.noSecret` (96), `issueImportCreateAsana`
  `asanaProjectName` (98), and `TeamUpdateInput.agentAutomationEnabled` /
  `codingAgentEnabled` (99). The SDK has been ESM-only since 97.0.0, which
  lebop's ESM build (`moduleResolution: bundler`) already supports.
- Refresh runtime dependencies: `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.29.0 → 1.32.1,
  `@toon-format/toon` 4.1.1 → 4.4.0, `chalk` 6.0.0 → 6.0.1, `yaml` 2.8.3 →
  2.9.1, `zod` 4.4.3 → 4.6.7. `bun.lock` was regenerated from scratch;
  `bun audit` now reports no known vulnerabilities. The previous lockfile
  carried 63 advisories (1 critical, 19 high). 47 came through the MCP SDK
  and its dependencies (mostly its HTTP server stack: hono, express and
  related packages; also `fast-uri` via `ajv`), and 16 came through dev
  tooling (vitest, vite). lebop serves MCP over stdio only, so the HTTP
  server advisories did not apply to it.
- MCP: the tool set is unchanged (17 tools in the `core` profile, 103 in
  `full`, same names). With zod 4.6, a nullable scalar parameter is now
  advertised as `"type": ["string", "null"]` rather than an `anyOf` of the
  two; the schemas are equivalent JSON Schema.
- Build and CI: compiled release binaries are built with Bun 1.4.4 (was
  1.3.13), and the darwin-arm64 binary is now built on macOS 15 because
  GitHub is retiring the macOS 14 runner image. Working from a source
  checkout now needs Bun 1.4.0+ because `bun.lock` uses lockfile format v2.
  The dev gates also need Node 22.12+ on `PATH` (vitest 5).
- Developer tooling: vitest 4.1.5 → 5.0.5, Biome 2.4.15 → 2.6.2 (config
  migrated; markdown formatting and linting stay off, so docs are left
  as-is), GitHub Actions artifact actions bumped and every action pinned
  by SHA with its version, Ubuntu runners pinned to `ubuntu-24.04`, and
  Dependabot moved to its `bun` ecosystem. Lint warnings were cleared
  without behavior changes.
- Extend the live-harness agent-session fixture gap allowlist expiry from
  2026-09-30 to 2026-12-31. The playground sandbox still has no external agent
  sessions, so the four id-based agent-session steps stay allowlisted gaps.

## Verification

- Full test suite (1414 tests), typecheck, Biome, actionlint, workflow
  action-pin check, package validation and `bun audit` passed on Bun 1.4.4
  and on the new floor, Bun 1.4.0. The compiled-binary smoke and the MCP
  `initialize` handshake passed for the release build, and all four release
  targets cross-compiled.
- Full live CLI and MCP playground-sandbox validation was run on the final
  tree (Bun 1.4.4), as well as on `@linear/sdk` 95.0.0 and 99.0.0 before the
  dependency refresh. Every run had 307 passed steps, 4 allowlisted
  agent-session gaps, and 0 failed steps, with identical step results across
  all three.
- Compiled-binary (linux-x64, Bun 1.4.4) full live smoke passed 307/4/0,
  with strict report validation including binary mode and SHA-256. The
  discovery live smoke passed 24/24.
- All resources created during live validation were verified cleaned up
  (remote destructive audit 33/33 on each full run).
